title: One source item, canonical form
description: OpenAI chat shape: `messages` plus a `tools` array. The system message carries the instruction and nothing else -- the catalog is data in `tools`, not text in a prompt. Rendering the catalog into the system message is a presentation step for people to read, and the only place it belongs is the annotation UI and the juror prompt.

tools.description: This record's catalog. Empty is a valid catalog and means the record offers no tools; it is not a missing value.

meta.description: The source's own fields, kept verbatim. Which of them mean something to the pipeline is declared in config/source/tool_decision.yaml, not in code.

$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose: a field the adapter does not understand must survive it, and the conformance suite proves that with a probe key.
